The '''kenalpa''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It had similarities to the [[Massassi tree/Legends|Massassi trees]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> Kenalpa trees were very common on the banks of Corellian rivers.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
